faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the STPINEXT Incubation Manager position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the STPINEXT Incubation Manager post is 04-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Incubation Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university. A Post-Graduation in Management is considered desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Incubation Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Incubation Manager position is 35 years. Relaxation may be provided for deserving candidates as per organizational policy.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Incubation Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Incubation Manager role will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 75,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for the STPINEXT Incubation Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Incubation Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Incubation Manager post at Software Technology Parks of India Next (STPINEXT).

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the STPINEXT Incubation Manager recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official STPINEXT website.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Incubation Manager position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Incubation Manager position is Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this STPINEXT Incubation Manager recruitment is STPI/NOI/COE/EPD/2025-2026/7.
